03 · Selected Work

Projects that show how I think.

Selected academic, industry-collaboration and internship projects.

FINAL YEAR PROJECT

Microwave Sensing for Wound Severity Classification Using Deep Learning

End-to-end AI application classifying wound severity from microwave S11 reflection signals.

  • Applied signal processing and Continuous Wavelet Transform (CWT) feature extraction.
  • Designed a custom CNN and benchmarked MobileNet, ResNet50, VGG16 and DenseNet121.
  • Achieved 100% classification accuracy on a phantom dataset of 1,200 scalogram images across four wound classes.
  • Demonstrated lightweight-model deployment on Raspberry Pi.
PythonDeep LearningCNNRaspberry PiSignal Processing
INDUSTRY COLLABORATION · KONICA MINOLTA

Automated Quality Inspection of Production Parts with AI-Powered Image Analysis

Computer-vision pipeline designed to automate defect detection in printer assembly verification.

  • Built an OpenCV and CNN-based image-analysis pipeline.
  • Integrated barcode validation for unit-level traceability.
  • Used MongoDB for inspection logging within the client's QA process.
OpenCVCNNMongoDBComputer Vision
INTERNSHIP PROJECT

EBeca Tourism Management System

Full-stack software development for a tourism booking platform.

  • Supported scalable full-stack development with Next.js.
